error_reason: The Planner agent swapped the birth years of the two directors in its updated understanding. It correctly identified Georges Méliès was born in 1861 and James Tinling was born later (around 1889 or 1898), but in the 'Updated Understanding' section, it incorrectly stated 'Christ Walking on the Water — Director: Georges Méliès — Birth year: 1898' and '45 Fathers — Director: James Tinling — Birth year: 1861'. This factual reversal leads to an incorrect final conclusion that the director of Christ Walking On The Water was born later.

suggested_fix.fix_text: Enforce a strict cross-verification step where the model explicitly lists each fact in a structured format (Director: Name, Movie: Title, Birth Year: X) before updating the internal state or final conclusion, preventing unconscious attribute swapping.
